prayers.name: Summon Molten Infernoth
prayers.effect: Set up a **Molten Infernoth** wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
prayers.declare: If there is not a friendly **Molten Infernoth** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Fyreslayers Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Summon Runic Fyrewall
prayers.effect: Set up a **Runic Fyrewall** wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.
prayers.declare: If there is not a friendly **Runic Fyrewall** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **Fyreslayers Priest** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Summon Zharrgron Flame-spitter
prayers.effect: Set up a **Zharrgron Flame-spitter** wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.
prayers.declare: If there is not a friendly **Zharrgron Flame-spitter** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Fyreslayers Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
